description: Empirical BMP (biochemical methane potential) lookup per feedstock with a thermophilic temperature de-rating curve. Numbers reused from EC141 F1b feedstock DB.
source: Angelidaki et al. (2009); Mata-Alvarez et al. (2014); Labatut et al. (2011)

feedstock_table.comment: BMP in L CH4 / kg VS at thermophilic optimum, reused verbatim from EC141 F1b.

temperature_curve.comment: Yield multiplier vs temperature (degC). Peak 1.0 at 55 C, drops outside thermophilic band 45-65.
